units.source_text: 但是，她预感到要逼她接客，就立即从伯母家逃走了。

en.t: But when she sensed that they were going to force her to take customers, she immediately ran away from her aunt's house.

units.source_text: 这也许是因为她念念不忘那“表彰的传闻”吧。

en.t: Perhaps this was because she could not stop thinking about that "rumor of commendation."
